Sections whose numbers end in **D** need **departmental clearance (D-clearance)** before you can register. Sections ending in **R** are limited only by room size: you can register if seats are open and you meet any other restrictions (prerequisites, major or class-level limits).

**Getting D-clearance:**
1. Look for the department's instructions at the top of the course listing in the Schedule of Classes; if there are none, contact the department offering the course (its phone, office or email is on its Web Registration page).
2. The **department** enters the clearance in the Student Information System (if it can't, the department emails the Registrar stating explicitly that it is granting you D-clearance). The Registrar can't grant D-clearance itself, and an instructor emailing the Registrar doesn't count.
3. Check **myInfo → Cleared Sections** in Web Registration, add the section to myCourseBin from there and register.

D-clearance is **section-specific**: you can register only in the section you were cleared for, so switching sections may need a new clearance. Departments can change a section from R to D at any time. Each department handles its own D-clearance process and requests can take time in busy periods, so follow up with the department.
